rules: When the Product UI/UX Designer classifies the outcome as Baseline Needed (initial bootstrap, correction, or refresh) for an existing frontend, send the fixed bootstrap payload defined in the product-prototype-repository-management skill, without the requirements or Product ticket package.

When the UI Baseline Bootstrapper classifies a bootstrap, correction, or refresh as Completed or Blocked, return the runnable baseline or precise blocker, the bootstrap report, source pin, and comparison evidence to the Product UI/UX Designer for acceptance or recovery.
